summary.goal: Enable seamless handoff from Ideation to Planner by sending session understanding directly to create or update a Plan.

acceptance_criteria.description: Session can be sent to Planner via API endpoint (anytime)
Plan inherits: goal (from initial_intent or override), context, understanding
Plan has source.type = 'ideation' and source.session_id
Session stores full PlannerSend snapshot (payload + result) in planner_sends[]
Subsequent sends append to planner_sends[], update the plan (new version with updated understanding)
Session stays active - user can continue ideating and send again
Interviewer can use send_to_planner tool
PlannerLead is notified when plan is created/updated from ideation

summary.notes: Sessions stay active after sending to planner. User can continue ideating and send updated understanding. This enables iterative refinement.

steps.title: Extend planner-core Plan schema for source
steps.description: Add source field to Plan entity to track origin

acceptance_criteria.description: Plan.source = { type: 'manual' | 'ideation' | 'intake', session_id?: string, signal_id?: string }
source field stored in plans table (JSONB)
Existing plans default to source.type = 'manual'

steps.title: Extend planner-core Plan schema for understanding
steps.description: Add understanding field to PlanVersion entity

acceptance_criteria.description: PlanVersion.understanding = Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> (freeform)
understanding field stored in plan_versions table (JSONB)
Existing versions default to empty understanding {}

steps.notes: This may already exist from schema-enrichment epic - verify and extend if needed

steps.title: Update POST /api/plans to accept source and understanding
steps.description: Extend create plan endpoint to accept ideation data

acceptance_criteria.description: CreatePlanRequest accepts optional source object
CreatePlanRequest accepts optional understanding object
Both are passed through to storage.createPlan()
Returns full Plan including source and understanding
Works on active sessions
If planner_sends is empty: creates new plan via planner-core API
If planner_sends has entries: creates new plan version with updated understanding
Appends PlannerSend to session.planner_sends (full payload snapshot)
Returns { session, plan_id, plan_version, plan_channel, is_update }

steps.title: Add send_to_planner tool to Interviewer
steps.description: Add tool definition and execution for sending to planner

acceptance_criteria.description: send_to_planner: { session_id, goal?, context? } -> calls send-to-planner endpoint
Returns { success, plan_id, plan_channel, is_update } on success
Interviewer can suggest sending when confidence is high

steps.title: Notify PlannerLead of plan from ideation
steps.description: Send Relay message to PlannerLead when plan is created/updated from ideation

acceptance_criteria.description: After successful send, message plan channel
Message includes: plan_id, session_id, is_update flag, goal
PlannerLead picks up message and welcomes/acknowledges the update
Test first send creates plan
Test subsequent sends update plan
Test understanding is preserved in plan
Test source is correctly set
Test session stays active after send
